info.title: IDPGitOps — F-003 Platform invariant gates
info.description: No HTTP surface. This feature is a set of validators invoked from pre-commit and from CI; its interface is a process exit code and an annotation on standard output. The paths object is empty for that reason, and the command surface is documented in api-contract_v4_F-003.md. Entity shapes are $ref'd from schemas.json.
